body:
This page collects the questions customers ask most about Nixodine products at One Stop Vape Store, with plain answers and links to our fuller guides. It covers what the term means, how the products are used, how strength is shown, what we do and do not claim, hardware and charging, flavors and brands, price and ordering, rules and returns and how to get help. It is written for adults aged 21 and over. We make no health claims about Nixodine or any product, and regulatory treatment of newer ingredients can change, so always check the label and your local rules.

## What is Nixodine?
A term used by brands for a nicotine-alternative active ingredient in some vapes. Different manufacturers may describe and source it differently, so read each label. See [what is Nixodine](/blog/what-is-nixodine/) for a full explanation, including what we do not claim.

## Does it contain nicotine?
Check the label of each product. We do not assume anything beyond what the manufacturer states. Strength is shown on our listings as the manufacturer writes it, for example "Nixodine 50" or "5% Nixodine". If you need to know more about a specific product, ask us, and we will tell you what the maker provides.

## How is it used?
Like other vapes: you inhale from a disposable, pod or tank device. Most of our Nixodine range is sealed disposables with a rechargeable battery and a mesh coil, plus some 100 mL bottles. See [how a vape works](/blog/how-does-a-vape-work/) and [how to choose a Nixodine device](/blog/how-to-choose-a-nixodine-device/).

## Does it have health benefits?
We make no health claims. We make no health claims about Nixodine or any product, and regulatory treatment of newer ingredients can change, so always check the label and your local rules. If you have health questions, speak to a licensed healthcare professional.

## Is it addictive?
We do not make claims either way, and you should not assume anything from the name of an ingredient. Products are for adults aged 21 and over. Read the label for warnings, and see [what the nicotine warning label means](/blog/what-the-nicotine-warning-label-means/) for how warnings work on nicotine products.

## Is it legal where I live?
Rules vary by state and city, and newer ingredients can be treated differently by regulators. See [state and local laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/) and [the FDA and vaping products](/blog/fda-and-vaping-products-what-adults-should-know/). If you are unsure, ask us with your state before you order. We may cancel an order that cannot be delivered lawfully.

## How many products and brands do you list?
Our catalog lists 162 Nixodine products from eleven brands: NIX Liquids, Geek Labs, Rinnbar, Rifbar, Lost Mary, Hotbox, Hookah Labs, YOVO, Juice Head, Parfflo and Fifty Bar. See [Nixodine brands compared](/blog/nixodine-brands-compared/).

## What do they cost?
Single devices list from about $14.99 to $19.99, with capacities from about 20,000 to 80,000 puffs. Many listings offer a 5-pack bundle, and there are some 100 mL bottles. Prices are on each product page. See [comparing prices per puff](/blog/how-to-compare-vape-prices-per-puff/).

## Are the devices rechargeable?
Many are, with a USB-C port. Check each product page. See [charging a disposable](/blog/how-to-charge-a-disposable/).

## Can I refill a disposable?
No. Disposables are sealed, and you should not try to open them.

## What flavors are available?
Mostly fruit, ice, tropical and candy blends, with some mint and dessert options. See [Nixodine flavors](/blog/nixodine-flavors-guide/).

## What is the return policy?
See the [refund policy](/refunds/). Opened or used products cannot be returned. Returns must be requested within 30 days with an RMA form, and a 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, which go back through the payment method you used. If a device arrives damaged, photograph it and email us. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/).

## How do I pay?
Cryptocurrency and gift cards get a 10% discount, and Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime are accepted. See [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/).

## How long does delivery take?
Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours and ship with tracking from our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse. Our published carrier estimates are 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US. An adult 21 or older must sign. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## Who can buy?
Adults aged 21 and over only. See [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/).

## How should I store and dispose of a device?
Keep it cool, dry and upright, away from children and pets, and take finished devices to a hazardous waste or electronics recycling site. See [Nixodine storage and use tips](/blog/nixodine-storage-and-use-tips/) and [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## What if my device does not work?
Check the charge, the airflow and the liquid. See [why a vape is not hitting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/) and [why a vape will not charge](/blog/vape-wont-charge-fixes/). If it is faulty, contact us with your order ID.

## How do I choose between products?
Use the checklist in [how to choose a Nixodine device](/blog/how-to-choose-a-nixodine-device/): ingredient, puff count and value, battery, flavor, brand, legality and policies.

## Can I get wholesale pricing?
Retailers can ask through our [wholesale page](/wholesale/). See the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/).

## Where can I get help?
Use the support chat on any page, the [contact page](/contact/), WhatsApp, phone or email. Customer service hours are Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 7PM Pacific Standard Time.

## Browse
See [Nixodine products](/shop/nixodine/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over.

## More questions we hear
### Can I try before I buy a bundle?
Buy a single unit first. Opened or used products cannot be returned, so a single unit is the safest way to learn whether you like a flavor.

### Can I use a Nixodine device on a plane?
Devices and batteries must travel in carry-on baggage, and you may not use them on board. See [traveling with vapes](/blog/traveling-with-vapes-airline-rules/).

### Are there Nixodine pouches?
Our pouch range is separate. See [nicotine pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/). Check each product's label for what it contains.

### Do you list ingredients for each product?
We list what the manufacturer provides on the product page. If you want more detail, ask us, and we will tell you what we know.

### Why do prices differ between brands?
Capacity, features and brand all affect price. Compare cost per 1,000 puffs.

### What if a product I like is out of stock?
Check related products on the same page, or contact us. Stock changes, and we can suggest similar listings.

### Can I buy for resale?
Retailers can ask about wholesale pricing through the [wholesale page](/wholesale/). Individuals can buy through the store at retail prices.

## Quick reference
- **Minimum order:** $100.
- **Free shipping:** $200 or more after discount.
- **Discount:** 10% for crypto and gift cards.
- **Processing:** 24 to 72 business hours.
- **Delivery:** adult signature, 21+.
- **Returns:** 30 days with an RMA, unopened items only, 15% restocking fee.
- **Contact:** Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 7PM Pacific Standard Time.

## If your question is not here
Ask us. Use the support chat, the [contact page](/contact/), WhatsApp, phone or email, and include your order ID if it concerns an order. We will answer plainly, and we will tell you if we do not know.

## More reading
See [what is Nixodine](/blog/what-is-nixodine/), [Nixodine vs nicotine](/blog/nixodine-vs-nicotine-guide/), [Nixodine disposables explained](/blog/nixodine-disposables-explained/) and [Nixodine flavors](/blog/nixodine-flavors-guide/). Every guide follows the same principle: we describe what manufacturers provide and make no health claims.

### A note on staying informed
Rules and products change. Check our policies and official sources from time to time, especially before a large order, and tell us if something you read seems to conflict with what we say.

## Frequently asked questions about orders for Nixodine products
### How do I order?
Open a product page, choose your options above the Add to Cart button, add it to your cart and check out. Confirm you are 21 or older, choose a payment method and place the order. We email you an order number and a private link. See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/).

### Can I use a gift card?
Yes. Apple, Razer Gold, Paysafe, Sephora and Macy's gift cards are accepted, and they save 10%. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

### Can I pay with crypto?
Yes: Bitcoin, USDT, USDC, Ethereum, BNB and Solana. Crypto saves 10%. See [the crypto payment FAQ](/blog/crypto-payment-faq/).

### Will my parcel say what is inside?
No. The outside is plain, with the shipping label and the legal label required for vapor shipments. See [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/).

### What if nobody can sign?
The carrier retries and may return the parcel, and a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and shipping cost applies. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

### Can I change my order?
Often before it is processing. Contact us with your order ID. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

### A last note on questions
If you have a question that we have not answered, or a concern about a product, please contact us. Our team would rather answer a question than have you guess, and your questions help us improve these guides. Include your order ID if it concerns an order, and tell us what you already know, so we can answer quickly and clearly.

### Where do I find our policies?
Our [shipping policy](/shipping/), [refund policy](/refunds/), [privacy policy](/privacy/) and [terms](/terms/) are linked in the footer of every page, and each is written to be read in plain language.
